title: Public forms that send email and store uploads are unthrottled
route: POST events/{event}/request, become-a-speaker, become-a-sponsor, contact (x2), newsletter
description: No throttle on public POSTs that email a user-supplied address and store 4-5 MB files.
expected_behavior: Per-IP and per-email limits on public submissions.
root_cause: Only login, workshop booking and invitation OTP routes have throttles.
exploitation_scenario: Script submits thousands of ticket requests with a victim's email: the domain mails the victim repeatedly and gets blocklisted; disk fills with uploads; coupon codes are guessed.
impact: Email deliverability loss (real tickets stop arriving), disk exhaustion, admin queue flooding.
remediation: Named RateLimiter per IP (e.g. 5/min) and per email (daily cap); optional honeypot/Turnstile.

title: Single privilege level: check-in staff are full admins
description: Both check-in and admin groups use plain auth; no roles, gates or policies exist.
evidence: routes/web.php:99,110; app/Models/User.php (no role); app/Policies absent; .claude/skills/event-domain.md:79 requires a distinct portal
expected_behavior: Door staff can only check people in.
actual_behavior: Any login can approve requests, issue free tickets, export attendee PII and delete events/ticket types.
exploitation_scenario: A temporary check-in account issues free invitations or exports the attendee CSV.
impact: Insider fraud, PII exposure, data destruction.
remediation: Add a role column + middleware/Gates; restrict the check-in role to check-in.* routes.

title: Payment stub issues paid tickets without charge via a GET link
description: Opening the signed approval link marks the ticket paid and issues it; double visits race and rotate the QR.
expected_behavior: Ticket issued only after server-confirmed payment, via a non-GET action.
actual_behavior: Link open (including by email link scanners) issues the ticket.
root_cause: Placeholder until a gateway is integrated.
exploitation_scenario: Any approved requester gets a free ticket; a mail scanner pre-fetch completes it automatically.
impact: Revenue loss if tickets are meant to be paid.
remediation: Integrate a gateway with webhook confirmation and POST completion, or document free issuance as accepted.

title: Review actions lack a server-side Pending guard
description: Status is overwritten regardless of the current state.
evidence: TicketRequestQueueController.php:49-59; SponsorRequestController.php:55-64; SpeakerRequestController.php:42-53. Runtime (rolled back): TicketIssued -> payment_pending; sponsor approved twice -> 2 sponsors.
expected_behavior: Only Pending requests can be approved/rejected.
actual_behavior: Issued tickets demoted (refused at check-in); duplicate sponsors/speakers.
root_cause: Guard exists only in Blade (hidden buttons).
exploitation_scenario: Double-click, stale tab, or a malicious staff account (SEC-02) re-approves an issued ticket to lock an attendee out.
impact: Paying attendees refused at the door; public site shows duplicates.

title: Coupon usage limit can be exceeded with parallel requests
description: Check (times_used < usage_limit) and increment are separate, unlocked steps.
actual_behavior: Concurrent requests can each redeem the last use.
exploitation_scenario: Holder of a limited code fires N parallel requests.
remediation: Conditional atomic increment and check affected rows.

title: Application sets no security headers
description: No CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, nosniff or Referrer-Policy in app middleware or .htaccess.
evidence: bootstrap/app.php middleware config; public/.htaccess; grep for header names -> none
actual_behavior: None set by the app (server may add some).
exploitation_scenario: Admin clickjacking; capability URLs leaking via Referer to external sites.
remediation: Header middleware; CSP in report-only first.

title: Production debug/cookie settings cannot be confirmed from the repo
description: .env.example ships APP_DEBUG=true, LOG_LEVEL=debug and no SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE; config/session.php secure defaults to null.
exploitation_scenario: If copied to production, errors leak stack traces and env data.
remediation: Verify production .env; add production values to deployment docs.

title: Admin seeder falls back to a default password
description: seed_password defaults to a well-known value when ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD is unset (seeder warns).
remediation: Confirm production password; fail the seeder in production when unset.

title: Unrestricted event slug reflected into SweetAlert html
description: Ticket reference (derived from slug) interpolated into html; slug validated only as string.
expected_behavior: Reference rendered as text; slug URL-safe.
actual_behavior: Admin-supplied markup would render for visitors.
remediation: alpha_dash on slug; set reference via textContent.

title: OTP limiter per IP only; session not regenerated after OTP
expected_behavior: Per-invitation attempt cap; session rotated on verification.
actual_behavior: Distributed guessing possible; session ID unchanged.

title: Deleting a ticket type deletes paid tickets
description: cascadeOnDelete on tickets.ticket_type_id and no guard in destroy().
actual_behavior: All tickets of the tier permanently removed.
impact: Attendees lose tickets; records unrecoverable without backups.

title: Dev-only postcss advisory
description: npm audit (incl. dev): postcss 1 high, 1 moderate; production tree clean.
exploitation_scenario: Requires attacker-controlled CSS/source maps at build time.
remediation: npm update at next routine maintenance.
